questions.question: Given a Composite Index on columns (A, B, C), which WHERE clause below CAN utilize this index?
questions.explanation: According to the Leftmost Prefix rule, a query must filter on the leading column (A) to utilize a B-Tree composite index on (A, B, C).

questions.question: What is the phenomenon where a transaction reads UNCOMMITTED data modified by another transaction?
questions.explanation: A Dirty Read occurs at the READ UNCOMMITTED isolation level when a transaction reads data that has not yet been committed (and may later be rolled back).
